kpis.description_fr: RCS = revenue récurrent in-game (GTA Online, NBA 2K MyTeam, Red Dead Online microtransactions). Plus haute marge. Modèle live ops.
kpis.description_en: RCS = recurring in-game revenue (GTA Online, NBA 2K MyTeam, Red Dead Online microtransactions). Higher margin. Live ops model.

kpis.description_fr: GTA Online MAU en décrue progressive 10 ans post-launch. Mais RCS toujours fort par user. Wait for GTA VI 2026.
kpis.description_en: GTA Online MAU progressively declining 10 years post-launch. But RCS per user still strong. Awaiting GTA VI 2026.

kpis.description_fr: Zynga acquis mai 2022 pour 12.7 Mds $. Apporte 50 % du CA bookings mobile (Words With Friends, Toon Blast). Diversification.
kpis.description_en: Zynga acquired May 2022 for $12.7B. Brings 50% of mobile bookings revenue (Words With Friends, Toon Blast). Diversification.

notes: Take-Two fiscal year se termine fin mars (FY25 = avr 2024-mar 2025).
